title: Gristle Bell
description: A gritty saw bass-stab in the mid register, sculpted by a snapping ladder filter envelope so each hit cracks like struck metal. Over 24 cycles it degrades through swelling distortion and a descending crush bit-depth, the broken character thickening as a detuned echo smears the tail.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<f2 f2 [~ ab2] f2 c2 f2 [eb2 ~] db2>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .penv("<0 0 7 -5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.04)
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(420, 2600)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(9, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(16).range(2.5, 5.5)).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.11)
    .attack(0.002).decay(0.16).sustain(0.18).release(0.05)
    .distort(sine.slow(24).range(0.2, 1.4))
    .crush("<16 12 9 6>/8")
    .coarse("<1 1 2 3>/16")
    .shape(0.32)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.32, 0.68))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(0.02, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.3).pan(0.75))
    .delay("0.28:0.1875:0.55").room(0.18).gain(0.92)
)
